name: saas-notification-center
context: Design a notification panel and inbox for a SaaS application. The audience is power users who receive frequent notifications about team activity, system alerts, mentions, and task updates. Target platforms: desktop (slide-over panel) and mobile (full-screen). The interface must handle high notification volume with grouping, filtering, bulk actions, and clear read/unread visual differentiation.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for notification titles, timestamps, and preview text
Apply color.rules.json to differentiate notification types (info, warning, error, success)
Unread indicator must use accent tokens with sufficient contrast against surface
Panel must support slide-over animation from Motion_Library enter-exit presets
Notification grouping must use clear visual hierarchy with date separators
Bulk actions (mark all read, clear all) must require confirmation for destructive ops
Comply with Quality_Gate: relative timestamps, no notification fatigue, proper grouping

outputCriteria.format: Notification panel spec with notification list, filters, grouping, bulk actions, empty state, and panel animation
qualityChecks: Unread notifications visually distinct via surface token or accent indicator
Notification types distinguishable by icon and subtle color token (not color alone)
Timestamps use relative format with typography.body.xs token
Empty state provides actionable guidance not just 'nothing here'
Panel entry/exit uses Motion_Library slide-over preset
accessibilityRequirements: New notifications announced via aria-live=polite region
Notification list uses proper list semantics with group labels
Unread count communicated in panel trigger button aria-label
Bulk action confirmations focus-trap to the confirm dialog
Each notification is keyboard activatable with clear focus indicators

examples.description: Notification panel with grouped items, unread indicator, and filter tabs
examples.output:
Organism: NotificationPanel
  Layout: flex(direction=column, height=100vh @mobile | 480px @desktop)
  width: 380px @desktop | 100% @mobile
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  shadow: var(--shadow-xl) @desktop
  motion: enter-exit.slide-in-right(duration: 250ms)
  role: dialog, aria-label: 'Notifications'
  Children:
    - Molecule: PanelHeader(flex, justify=space-between, padding=space.md)
        - Atom: Heading(level=h2, token=typography.heading.sm, text='Notifications')
        - Atom: Button(variant=ghost, size=sm, label='Mark all read')
    - Molecule: FilterTabs(role=tablist)
        - Atom: Tab(label='All', active=true, border-bottom=color.action.primary)
        - Atom: Tab(label='Mentions', active=false)
        - Atom: Tab(label='Alerts', active=false)
    - Organism: NotificationList(flex=1, overflow=auto, role=list)
        - Atom: DateSeparator(text='Today', token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.tertiary)
        - Molecule: NotificationItem(unread=true)
            padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
            bg: var(--color-surface-unread)
            border-left: 3px solid var(--color-action-primary)
            - Atom: Avatar(size=sm, src=user.avatar)
            - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.primary)
            - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.xs, color=color.text.tertiary, text='2m ago')
        - Molecule: NotificationItem(unread=false)
            padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
            bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
    - Molecule: EmptyState(hidden when has items)
        - Atom: Icon(name=bell-off, color=color.text.tertiary, size=48)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, text='All caught up')
acceptanceCriteria: Panel uses dialog role with slide-in motion from Motion_Library
Unread items have distinct surface token and accent border indicator
Filter tabs use proper tablist/tab roles for accessibility
Date separators group notifications with tertiary text tokens
Empty state provides meaningful feedback with icon and text
